style: 2017 Beijing, documentary cinematic illustration, painterly photoreal, muted desaturated palette, overcast rainy mood, soft 35mm film grain, natural available light. STRICT: no text, no watermarks, no logos, no readable brand names or signage; do NOT depict any recognizable real person's face; the protagonist (a slim young man, early 20s, cheap delivery raincoat) is always shown from behind, in silhouette, or first-person POV, face never clearly visible. Wide cinematic landscape framing.

images.prompt: A night train platform in Beijing, sodium-vapor lamps, a slim young man carrying luggage walking away from camera along the platform, tired but hopeful, humid summer night.

Afternoon outside a generic Chinese university gate (no readable signage), a brand-new electric delivery scooter parked at the curb, a young couple standing beside it seen from behind, warm proud moment.
A young man riding a new electric scooter along a wide multi-lane Beijing avenue, late afternoon light, back view, wind in his shirt, optimistic momentum.
A drab suburban depot yard on an overcast morning, a young man collecting delivery gear and a uniform from cardboard boxes, isolated and small in the frame.
A university campus building at dusk, a delivery rider with an insulated food bag walking toward the entrance, back view, first delivery, quiet tension.
3 a.m. light rain, a lone electric scooter parked under a residential apartment block, wet pavement reflecting a single streetlamp, nobody around, melancholy.
A violent summer downpour near a leafy university campus, a delivery rider on an electric scooter soaked through a flimsy plastic raincoat, back view, headlights and rain streaks, cold and exhausted.
Under a concrete pedestrian overpass during a rainstorm, a rider sheltering, wiping a wet phone screen with the dry part of his shirt, grey light, water pouring beyond the shelter.
Interior of a cheap noodle shop, a small bowl of beef noodles steaming on a worn laminate table, rain-streaked window, a tired figure seated, muted warmth.
A wide street intersection at dusk in the rain, an electric scooter stopped at the roadside with an obviously flat rear tire, a young man crouching to check it, back view, headlights smearing.
A tangle of highway flyover ramps at nightfall, a small figure on a shared bicycle lost among the interchanges, the river of car lights far below and out of reach, disorienting scale.
Night, light rain near a bus stop, a young man frozen mid-step patting an empty chest pouch under his raincoat, dawning despair, back view, cold blue streetlight.
Late night rain, a dim roadside scene, a young man pushing an electric scooter with a flat tire toward a tiny bike-repair stall lit by a bare bulb, an older stranger with a bicycle pointing the way.

Interior of a crowded electronics mall, second-floor phone-selling floor, harsh cold fluorescent light, generic booths (no readable brands), a lone young customer facing intimidating vendors, tense and claustrophobic.
An afternoon city street under bright sun after rain, a flustered delivery rider hurrying on foot with several food bags, harried body language, back view.
Night, a thunderstorm and rain streaking the window, a young man at a small cramped desk writing in a notebook under a warm desk lamp, seen from behind and slightly to the side, introspective.
Late afternoon at a plain depot near an outer district, a young man handing back an electric scooter, deflated posture, overcast, end-of-the-road mood.
A small roadside eatery in the evening, a bottle of beer and a bowl of crossing-bridge rice noodles on the table, a weary young man seated, warm tired relief after a hard day.
